jobs.description: Company description:At NKT in Karlskrona, we develop and manufacture high voltage power cables that enable the transition to renewable energy. Here, you will be part of an international engineering centre with advanced high voltage test halls, modern cable production and the cable laying vessel NKT Victoria. As Connectors, we collaborate to develop innovative technology that connects a greener and more sustainable world. NKT is headquartered in Denmark and operates in more than 30 countries.NKT - We connect a greener world. www.NKT.com.Job description:Shape smart HR processes by bridging people and systemsDo you want to play an important role in supporting people, processes and technology within a global organization supporting the green transition? As an HR Coordinator at NKT, you will contribute to delivering efficient, compliant and people-focused HR services across the entire employee lifecycle. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys combining HR administration, process improvement and system support in an international environment. You will work across the entire employee lifecycle, supporting managers and HR colleagues while contributing to efficient, compliant, and future-proof HR processes. This is a 12-month parental leave cover, offering a great opportunity to gain practical experience in both day-to-day HR delivery and HR transformation initiatives. Support and develop smart HR operationsAs HR Coordinator, you will be a key link between HR, Payroll and IT, ensuring high-quality HR operations and a seamless employee experience. You will work with HR administration, employee data, reporting and HR systems while supporting managers, employees and HR colleagues. In addition to supporting day-to-day HR operations, you will have the opportunity to contribute to HR transformation initiatives and projects, including continuous development of HRIS/HCM platforms and other digital HR solutions. Key responsibilities include:•    Manage HR administration, including hires, changes and exits•    Prepare employment contracts and HR-related documentation•    Support onboarding and offboarding activities•    Maintain employee data and ensure data quality across HR systems•    Contribute to HR systems, process improvement, digitalization, training and user support initiatives You will be part of the HR Operations team and collaborate closely with Payroll, HR Business Partners, managers and IT colleagues. The position is based in Karlskrona, Sweden. Structured and service-minded with digital curiosityYou thrive in an environment that values accuracy, service and teamwork. With a structured mindset and attention to detail, you enjoy working with digital tools, data and HR processes. We believe you are genuinely curious about systems and enjoy discovering smarter ways of working. You are motivated by continuous improvement and have an interest in how technology can enhance HR processes and the employee experience. You are motivated to learn, understand how systems, data and processes work together, and contribute to building efficient and user-friendly HR solutions. In addition you have:•    Experience in HR administration or a similar administrative role•    Solid system understanding and interest in digital tools and processes•    Good communication skills in Swedish and English•    Experience working with employee data and HR documentation Experience with SuccessFactors or similar HRIS/HCM platforms is considered an advantage. Support people and systems driving growth NKT is dedicated to building a diverse organization and a culture in which people from all backgrounds can thrive and do their best work. We believe that a diverse organization enables sustainable performance, and that an inclusive and welcoming culture makes for a better place to work. This role offers a great opportunity to develop your HR expertise in an international and collaborative environment. You will gain exposure to HR operations, digitalization initiatives, HR technology, reporting, and process development while working alongside experienced HR professionals. At NKT, you will have the opportunity to grow your skills, expand your knowledge of HR systems and transformation, and contribute to creating modern HR solutions that support both people and business success. As a leader, I believe in creating an environment where people are supported, trusted, and encouraged to develop. In this role, you will have the opportunity to contribute to both daily HR operations and exciting development initiatives while working closely with experienced colleagues across the business," says Hiring Manager, Mia Eliasson. Read more about our offer and listen to some voices of NKT Connectors here!  We will review applications continuously, but we recommend you apply no later than 2026-11-15. An extract from the criminal record, alcohol- and drug tests, medical tests along with personality tests, will be part of our recruitment process.  Be a Connector of the green tomorrow!

jobs.occupation: Tour guides for Stockholm - Part time freelance
jobs.description:
Part-time freelance | Small Groups

Do people describe you as a storyteller? Are you the friend who always ends up explaining the history, recommending the hidden café, or connecting the dots? Do you love Stockholm — not just the postcard version, but the layers beneath it?

Then keep reading.

About Amitylux

Amitylux is a multi-award-winning boutique travel company creating high-touch, personal guided experiences across the Nordics and the UK. We focus on small groups, meaningful conversations, and experiences that feel natural rather than scripted. Our tours are relaxed, human, and built around connection. We value calm, confident leadership. We value thoughtful storytelling that adapts to the group. We value presence, awareness, and reading the room. Our guests come from all over the world — from curious leisure travellers to corporate and VIP groups. What they all appreciate is authenticity, quality, and a genuine sense of welcome rather than being processed.

You Might Be a Great Fit If You:

• 
Can turn strangers into friends within a few hours

• 
Feel comfortable leading while staying warm and approachable

• 
Have lived in Stockholm long enough to truly understand it

• 
Plan to stay and grow here

• 
Speak fluent English (additional languages are a strong plus)

• 
Enjoy walking and being outdoors

• 
Understand that guiding is both performance and hospitality

This is not about memorising dates. It’s about creating a feeling people remember.

What You’ll Experience With Us

• 
A supportive, high-standard team culture

• 
Autonomy and trust

• 
The chance to meet people from around the world

• 
The opportunity to grow your leadership and storytelling skills

• 
Being part of a brand that cares deeply about guest experience

We take pride in what we do — and we look for people who feel the same.

Join us on this journey — and help shape meaningful travel experiences in Stockholm. 

Application

We review candidates continuously and close once we find the right match.

Please note: Applications are only accepted via our hiring platform on The Hub. We are unable to review applications sent by email or other channels.

Important: Your application must include a short personal video introducing yourself and explaining why you would be a great fit for Amitylux. Applications without a video will not be considered.

(The Hub allows you to record directly. Pre-recorded files can be added as a link or file.)

IMPORTANT! To be part of the hiring process, please apply through our hiring platform in The Hub.

Job link to apply- https://thehub.io/jobs/6ad5291d43c5ab4c69336fe7

At Umain, we're not just creating software; we're crafting the future, one innovative project at a time. With our motto "Shape, Ship, Scale," we empower our team to not only envision the future but also play a pivotal role in building it. We're a dynamic team where you can shape the future, ship groundbreaking solutions, and scale your abilities in many different ways.We're on the lookout for QA Engineers who see testing as more than checking features. You understand that the purpose of testing is to make risks visible and reduce uncertainty, and you care about improving not only the product but also how the team ensures quality.You enjoy methodical, structured testing, but you're equally curious about automation, AI-assisted tooling, and how to make testing smarter, faster, and better integrated into the delivery flow.What We Offer:    A chance to work on unique projects that explore and push the boundaries of what's possible.        A fun and fair work environment where your you have the opportunity to expand your skills through unique challenges and fantastic colleagues.        A personal coach, and a setting where you can grow professionally and personally.        Being part of multidisciplinary teams, participating in agile teams, being an important player in a highly ambitious setting.As a QA Engineer at Umain, your role will involve:    Analysing user stories and requirements to identify risks and define test cases        Design, execute, and maintain functional, regression, and exploratory tests        Build and extend automated tests for UI, API, or backend        Collaborate with developers to integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines        Report and communicate quality insights, focusing on what the results mean        Suggest and implement improvements in testing practices, tools, and processes — including leveraging AI to work smarterWhat you bringStructured and analytical testing skills    Strong understanding of structured and risk-based test design, drawing on principles from frameworks such as ISTQB or TMAP        Experience across different test levels including component, integration, system, and UAT        Ability to design, prioritise, and maintain test cases based on business impact and riskAutomation and technical mindset    Hands on experience with modern automation tools such as Cypress, Playwright, Appium or Postman        Comfortable writing basic scripts in JavaScript, TypeScript, or Python        Understanding of APIs, JSON, and CI/CD pipelines such as GitLab, Azure DevOps, or Jenkins        Treats automation as part of the product codebase, versioned, reviewed, and maintained        Actively explores how AI tools (such as GitHub Copilot, AI-assisted test generation, or LLM-based exploration) can support and enhance testing workCollaboration and communication    Works closely with developers, designers, and product owners to clarify and test assumptions early        Communicates findings clearly and constructively, focusing on understanding and action        Helps stakeholders make informed release decisions by putting risks into contextOwnership, growth and continuous improvement    Actively invests in your own development, you follow the field, experiment with new approaches, and push yourself to keep growing        Takes initiative to improve how the team works instead of waiting for others to define it    Brings ideas for smarter ways of testing or automating repetitive work        Contributes to making quality a shared team responsibilityExperience we’d love to see    3 to 6 years of experience in QA, test engineering, or a similar quality focused role        Experience working in agile, iterative delivery environments such as Scrum or Kanban        Exposure to end to end digital product development across web, mobile, or backend systems        Experience from consultancy or multi client projects is a plus        Fluent in English; other languages are an advantageWhy Umain?    Career Framework:    We believe in fairness and clarity, which is why we've established a transparent career framework to ensure equal pay and equal opportunities for all. Your growth and success are as important to us as they are to you. Together with your coach, you will build your own development plan and grow in your career.    Work-Life Balance:    At Umain, diversity is our strength. We understand that life doesn’t pause when you walk into the office. That's why we've cultivated an environment that supports an excellent work-life balance. We welcome team members from all walks of life, recognizing the richness that different backgrounds, ages, and life stages bring to our team. We're committed to supporting each other, encouraging a healthy work-life balance that respects your needs, whether it's taking care of your family, your pets, or yourself.    Innovations and Learning:    Technology is always evolving, bringing new challenges and opportunities for collaboration and learning. Our developers work closely with designers, analysts, testers and more to tackle these challenges head-on, sharing knowledge and growing together.    Skills Over Degrees:    We’re more interested in what you can do than in the diplomas you hold. Talent, drive, and creativity are what count at Umain. Here, you’ll find opportunities to grow, learn, and excel in your career, regardless of your educational background. If you have the ambition and commitment to succeed, we have the environment and resources to support your journey.Are You Ready to Shape, Ship, and Scale with Us?If you're a QA Engineer who thrives on innovation, values a supportive and inclusive workplace, and is eager to make a tangible impact on the future, we’d love to hear from you. Let’s build something awesome together.Background checkUmain conducts a background check for final candidates in accordance with our internal policies. The check is carried out only with your consent and is ordered by our CISO through our approved screening partner. The scope of the check depends on the role level. This step is performed late in the recruitment process and is used solely to support a secure and fact‑based hiring decision.

About us Ingrid was born out of a simple belief: the energy transition must move faster and work smarter. Technical expertise in energy markets and understanding of grid infrastructure.    Fluency in English; additional languages are a plus.Your personal skillsIn addition to relevant work experience, we’re looking for someone with the right personal skills and motivation, and a genuine passion for renewable energy.    Strong negotiation and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage effectively at all levels.    Structured problem-solver who enjoys tackling complex challenges creatively and pragmatically.    A relationship-builder who understands counterparties' perspectives and resolves issues with a positive impact.    Self-driven and proactive — takes initiative, leads projects independently, and continuously seeks to improve.    Resilient and collaborative, thriving in fast-paced environments while keeping internal and external stakeholders aligned.Why join us?At Ingrid, we're pioneers at the forefront of the global energy transition — pushing boundaries, turning bold ideas into reality, and solving what matters most. Our culture is built on Bold Impact · Curious Grit · Inspiring Collaboration. We believe a thriving organisation runs on trust, growth, and learning from mistakes — and that wellbeing matters as much as work. From team workouts to social activities, we make space to connect, recharge, and thrive together.Next stepWe’ll make selections on an ongoing basis and finalize the recruitment as soon as we’ve found the perfect match.We look forward to hearing from you!/Team Ingrid

About VolumentalVolumental is a FitTech™ company used by footwear brands and retailers, matching people with shoes that truly fit through 3D scanning and machine learning.Our vision is "a world without sizes, where every body fits". We work with brands like New Balance, Red Wing, Fleet Feet, and Vivobarefoot across 3,000+ stores in 60 countries, with 60M+ foot scans collected, one of the world's largest datasets of its kind.We've always been an AI company at our core. Today, that extends beyond the product into how we build, using AI agents and strong self-serve tooling to move faster from idea to production. Where you fit in  Every scan in every one of those stores, and every recommendation we give, depends on infrastructure that has to work while a shopper is standing in front of a clerk. Our platform runs on Kubernetes on Google Cloud, is managed as code, is deployed through GitOps, and is observed through Grafana. What we’re looking for is someone who treats that platform as a product: one our developers can self-serve on, that holds up when things go wrong, and that is ready for new kinds of workloads.This is a hands-on Platform Engineer role. Most days you'll be shipping and running infrastructure with Terraform, Helm and ArgoCD, keeping an eye on our systems through Grafana, and building tools in Go that let developers get what they need without waiting on anyone. You'll also spend time explaining technical tradeoffs and writing docs that others can act on.AI is changing the industry, and we see it as an opportunity to empower people. By automating toil and mechanical tasks across the organisation, people can focus on the architectural, novel, and creative work. You will be right at the centre of this transformation, enabling not only yourself and your team’s work, but ensuring that the company can leverage AI and accelerate as a whole.Things you'll do:     Ship and run production infrastructure on Kubernetes and GCP, managed as code with Terraform and deployed with Helm and ArgoCD    Define SLOs and build monitoring and alerting in Grafana that tells us when stores and shoppers are actually affected    Take part in on-call, lead incident response, and run postmortems that turn into real fixes    Build tools in Go that let developers self-serve on environments, deployments and access    Explain technical tradeoffs to engineers, product managers and leadership, and write documentation others can act on    Leverage AI agents to compress routine work, redirecting the time saved into reliability and platform improvements    Help strengthen how we handle access, secrets, certificates and image security alongside the wider teamWe are excited about you because:    You have 3+ years of experience running production infrastructure in an SRE, DevOps or Platform role    You've been on-call for production systems on Kubernetes and a major cloud provider, ideally GCP, and have led incident response and postmortems    You can set up SLO-based monitoring and alerting, and you're comfortable managing infrastructure as code with Terraform    You write clean, maintainable, cloud-native code in at least one language such as Go or Python    You have solid systems knowledge and troubleshoot methodically across the stack    You're comfortable with ambiguity and enjoy finding the right problem and seeing it throughBonus - Don't let these stop you from applying, but please let us know if you have experience with:    Deploying and running AI agent workloads and tool servers (such as MCP), with sandboxing, rate limiting and observability of agent actions    Security: identity and access management, authentication (OAuth/OIDC, SSO), certificate and TLS/mTLS management, secrets handling, network hardening, vulnerability management, and image hardening and scanning    Compliance frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC 2 or GDPR    Database operations and migrations    Running workloads across multiple cloud providers or regulated regions What we can offer you:    Personal learning budget and access to coaching    Opportunity to work with a great team of 20+ nationalities in our English-speaking office    Occupational pension at ITP1 level    Flexible Public Holidays Policy    Options Program    Parental pay top-up    Wellness allowance    Flexible work policy (at least 3 days a week from our Stockholm office) The monthly compensation range for this role in Stockholm is 52,000-66,000 SEK. Actual compensation will depend on level, experience, and skillset as assessed in the interview process.This is a full-time position based at our Stockholm headquarters. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds! If this role excites you but you don't meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply - we'd love to hear from you.Feel free to include a link to your GitHub or anything you've built or operated that you're proud of.How we hireWe use generative AI to assist the people running our recruitment process, for example in preparing interviews. People are in the loop at every stage, and every decision about your application is made by a human.

jobs.occupation: Master Thesis: AI for Real-Time Microstructure Monitoring Using Laser Ultra
jobs.description: Project Description Background Laser Ultrasonics (LUS) is a powerful non-contact technique for in-situ characterization of metallic materials at elevated temperatures. In hot strip mill environments, LUS enables real-time monitoring of grain size evolution through analysis of ultrasonic wave attenuation and velocity, providing critical insight into recrystallization, grain growth, and phase transformations. This information is highly valuable for advanced process control strategies aimed at improving product quality, consistency, and resource efficiency. The NAICE project (Non-destructive AI enhanced online grain size evaluation) addresses a key challenge in fossil free steel production: today’s steel mills lack real time information about the microstructure that governs material quality, leading to unnecessary energy use, scrap, and slow process adjustments. By upgrading the world’s only industrial laser ultrasonic grain size gauge and collecting a unique large dataset, the project will train models to enable AI enhanced measurement of the grain size and microstructure in real-time. This enables smarter process control, higher yield, and reduced emissions. This thesis is the first of two planned master thesis works. The first will evaluate the best options using historical data sets, whereas the second will focus on using the full dataset and optimizing the model for industrial implementation. If you want to know more about the LUS technology and the installation of the world’s only grain size gauge there is a recorded webinar here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZOpXUAPhEv0&t=665s  Thesis Scope The thesis will focus on the application of machine learning and AI techniques to Laser Ultrasonic (LUS) data acquired in a hot strip mill environment. The available dataset consists of:     Raw LUS A-scan signals with multiple backwall echoes (20 µs duration, 1 ns resolution)     Grain size values calculated using an established conventional algorithm (serving as reference values)     The primary objective is to develop and evaluate AI-based approaches for: - Grain size prediction directly from raw laser ultrasonic signals - Microstructure state classification (e.g., recrystallized fraction, pancaking/aspect ratio) A key part of the work will be to survey suitable AI architectures, such as time-series models, deep learning approaches, and alternative signal-processing-informed models, and assess their applicability to the LUS data. Tasks     Survey and critically assess relevant AI/ML architectures for ultrasonic time-series data     Pre-process and structure high-resolution LUS A-scan datasets for model training     Develop and implement selected AI models     Perform benchmark comparisons between different approaches with respect to:      Prediction accuracy     Robustness to signal variability     Computational efficiency and suitability for real-time deployment     Analyze model interpretability in relation to known physical phenomena Expected Outcomes The thesis should deliver:     A structured comparison of candidate AI approaches for LUS-based grain size prediction     Prototype models demonstrating feasibility on the historical dataset     Recommendations for model selection in future industrial implementation Desired Qualifications We are looking for a motivated student with:     A background in computer engineering, engineering physics, materials science, applied mathematics, or similar     Strong interest in machine learning and signal processing     Experience with Python/Matlab and ML frameworks     Basic understanding of wave physics, ultrasonics, or materials science (meriting but not required)     Analytical mindset and ability to work with complex datasets Additional Information     The work will be carried out in close collaboration with experts in Laser Ultrasonics and industrial process monitoring, providing a unique opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge development of AI-driven process control in steel manufacturing. Project time The project is intended for a master thesis (30hp), starting in spring 2027 or can be mutually decided through negotiations. Further information This project is intended to be performed at Swerim in Stockholm. Swerim rewards the student with 50 000 SEK for an approved master thesis (30hp). Contacts For further information please contact:      Mikael Malmström, mikael.malmstrom@swerim.se     Hampus Wikmark Kreuger, hampus.wikmark@swerim.se Application Apply by using the application function below. The application can be written in Swedish (or English). You will receive a confirmation that Swerim has received your application. Please note that we fill the position as soon as we find a suitable applicant, which means there is no explicit deadline.
